subject: Phase 100260: Retention Mission Policy and Coding-Agent First-Run Defaults
verdict_justification: The developer successfully implemented the core deterministic mission engine, coding-agent defaults, and fixture calibration with 100% passing tests and high coverage across all crates. However, adversarial review revealed a broken JSON Schema $ref in the published tool schema pack, an omission of secret pattern validation at profile set time, and minor header standard non-compliances.
standard: AGENTS.md file size constraint (<= 450 lines) and header structure
Roadmap phase 100260 requirements, acceptance criteria, and security constraints
Full workspace test pass and >=90% line and function coverage per file
PR-3 closed taxonomy, PR-5 logged decisions, FR-20 versioned schema pack
Safe upgrade behavior with zero unexpected state mutation

requirements.requirement: Task 1: Mission Schema and Specificity Guardrails
requirements.evidence: Schema, validation caps, duplicate checks, and specificity lint implemented; however, the published JSON Schema carries an invalid $ref pointer, and secret pattern rejection was omitted.

requirements.requirement: Task 2: Deterministic Mission Influence on Admission
requirements.evidence: Arithmetic utility adjustments (-0.30 drop / +0.15 keep), drop veto with mission_drop reason, gate order preservation, and audit rule IDs are fully implemented and verified in tests.
coding_default_profile implemented with standard 20-line chatter fixture calibrating to 4 admit / 16 drop; wired to new repo: banks at resolution time.
Regex evaluation is timeout-bounded by a 50k step budget, and labels scrub secrets in previews; however, mission examples with secret patterns are not rejected at set time.
Tool schema pack carries mission properties and descriptions, but profile_json_schema contains a broken $ref pointer and MCP tools omit x-mission-entry.
All 48 files are strictly <= 450 lines (max 443 lines), but four new test files omit the required //! # Responsibility header section.

issues.title: Broken JSON Schema $ref pointer in published profile_json_schema and missing definition in MCP tool schemas
issues.why_it_matters: MCP clients and tooling validating tool calls or config against profile_json_schema fail with PointerToNowhere errors because the $ref points to /properties/mission/x-mission-entry which does not exist. Furthermore, x-mission-entry is missing from the MCP tool schemas.
issues.impact: Any standard JSON Schema validator fails on tool parameter validation for retention_profile_set and admit_preview_batch.
issues.evidence: crates/clio-config/src/retention_schema.rs:105, 112, 123. Running python jsonschema.validate() produces '_WrappedReferencingError PointerToNowhere: /properties/mission/x-mission-entry does not exist'.
issues.proposed_fix: Move x-mission-entry into definitions or under mission.properties, update the $ref paths to point correctly to the definition, and ensure schema_retention_defs embeds the definition.

issues.title: Secret-bearing mission patterns are not rejected at set time and persist unmasked in profile configuration
issues.why_it_matters: Section 7 Security Constraints explicitly requires: 'Never commit secrets; mission examples containing secret patterns are rejected with guidance to use hygiene tooling instead.' Unchecked examples store credentials in plaintext on disk.
issues.impact: Users or tools providing secret patterns in keep/drop examples cause raw API keys or passwords to be persisted in profiles.json.
issues.evidence: crates/clio-config/src/retention_mission.rs:143-215 (RetentionMission::validate). Executing 'am retention set' with an api_key string succeeds and writes the unmasked credential to disk.
issues.proposed_fix: Add secret pattern detection using clio_config::secret to RetentionMission::validate(), returning an InvalidArgument error guiding the user to hygiene tools.

issues.title: Pre-existing unconfigured repo: banks automatically switch to coding_default_profile on upgrade without mention in Known Limitations
issues.why_it_matters: Existing banks created before Phase 100260 with repo: prefix that did not set an explicit profile previously had balanced verbosity and no mission; after upgrade they immediately resolve coding default.
issues.impact: Unexpected admission behavior change for pre-existing unconfigured repositories without notice in Known Limitations.
issues.evidence: crates/clio-config/src/retention_store.rs:106-109 applies coding_default_profile to all repo: banks lacking a stored profile. Phase file §9 and §12 Known Limitations do not disclose this upgrade behavior.
issues.proposed_fix: Document in §9 and §12 Known Limitations that pre-existing repo: banks without stored profiles resolve coding_default_profile rather than the builtin default.

issues.title: Missing # Responsibility and AGENTS.md module header structure in newly added and modified Rust test files
issues.why_it_matters: AGENTS.md strictly requires every Rust source file to use the exact responsibility/ownership header structure.
issues.impact: Code style and architectural boundary documentation inconsistency.
issues.proposed_fix: Add //! # Responsibility and the standard ownership/boundary comments to all four test files.

findings.title: Broken JSON Schema $ref pointer in published profile_json_schema and missing definition in MCP tool schemas
findings.evidence: crates/clio-config/src/retention_schema.rs:105, 112 points $ref to '#/properties/mission/x-mission-entry' which does not exist (x-mission-entry is at the schema root). jsonschema.validate fails with PointerToNowhere.
findings.recommendation: Move x-mission-entry definition inside $defs / definitions or directly under mission properties, and ensure MCP tool schemas in crates/clio-mcp/src/schema_retention_defs.rs include the entry definition.

findings.title: Secret-bearing mission patterns are not rejected and persist unmasked in profile configuration
findings.evidence: crates/clio-config/src/retention_mission.rs:143-215 (RetentionMission::validate). Executing 'am retention set --bank testbank --profile ...' with api_key=sk-... succeeds and writes raw secret to profiles.json on disk.
findings.recommendation: Add secret pattern detection to RetentionMission::validate() using clio-config::secret markers, rejecting any secret-bearing mission with guidance to use hygiene tooling.

findings.title: Pre-existing unconfigured repo: banks automatically switch to coding_default_profile on upgrade without mention in Known Limitations
findings.evidence: crates/clio-config/src/retention_store.rs:106-109 applies coding_default_profile to all repo: banks lacking a stored profile. Phase file §9 and §12 Known Limitations do not disclose this upgrade behavior.
findings.recommendation: Document in §9 and §12 Known Limitations that pre-existing repo: banks without stored profiles resolve coding_default_profile rather than the builtin default.

findings.title: Missing # Responsibility and AGENTS.md module header structure in newly added and modified Rust test files
findings.evidence: crates/clio-admission/src/decision_mission_tests.rs:1-6, crates/clio-config/src/mission_match_tests.rs:1-6, crates/clio-config/src/retention_mission_tests.rs:1-6 lack '//! # Responsibility'. crates/clio-lib/tests/retention_mission_harness.rs:1-5 lacks all AGENTS.md header sections.
findings.recommendation: Add the standard //! # Responsibility, //! ## Owns, //! ## Does not own, and //! ## Boundary doc comments to these test files.

dismissed: Step-budget exhaustion handling: initially suspected unbounded recursion or memory leaks; verified that step-budget of 50,000 steps deterministically cuts off ReDoS patterns and logs once.
Category gate bypass risk: verified that Category::parse and gate_reject run before five-factor scoring and mission evaluation; keep bonus cannot rescue category rejection.
File length limit violation: checked all 48 modified/created files; all are under the 450-line limit.
Aggregate and per-file coverage floors: verified using make coverage and awk scan that all files exceed 90% lines and functions.

unknowns.what: Downstream behavior of memory-constrained environments on deep regex backtracking
unknowns.why_unknown: Step budget is 50,000 steps which is safe on 8MB stacks, but recursion could consume stack frames on tight embedded threads.
unknowns.what_would_resolve_it: Convert regex matcher from recursion to an iterative loop with explicit state stack.
unknowns.materiality: Low for CLI/desktop, Medium for constrained runtimes.

strengths: Zero-allocation FNV-1a 64 content hashing provides deterministic, stable rule IDs across edits.
Complete gate-order preservation: category gate and span verification are strictly evaluated before scoring and cannot be overridden by keep bonuses.
High test coverage with comprehensive scenario testing across 44 suites plus an integration harness.
All 48 staged files comply with the 450-line file length limit, including refactored schema modules.
regrets: Did not run standard external JSON Schema validators against published tool schemas during dev phase, missing the dangling $ref pointer.
Did not add explicit security test cases attempting to set secret tokens in mission examples.
process_changes: Incorporate automated JSON Schema reference validation into schema-pack tests.
Add negative security test suites specifically targeting credential injection in config fields.
plan_1hr: Fix JSON pointer in crates/clio-config/src/retention_schema.rs so $ref correctly resolves to the entry schema.
Add secret-pattern rejection in RetentionMission::validate() and add unit test verifying rejection with hygiene guidance.
Update crates/clio-mcp/src/schema_retention_defs.rs to properly include the entry definition in MCP tool schemas.
Fix doc comment headers in decision_mission_tests.rs, mission_match_tests.rs, retention_mission_tests.rs, and retention_mission_harness.rs to include //! # Responsibility.
plan_unlimited: Implement an iterative (non-recursive) regex matcher in mission_match.rs to ensure zero risk of stack overflow on deeply nested repetitions in memory-constrained thread environments.
Add integration tests in clio-mcp validating the entire published schema pack using an authoritative JSON Schema draft validator.
Add a migration/opt-in mechanism allowing bank operators to explicitly choose whether existing pre-Phase-100260 repo: banks adopt coding_default_profile or retain builtin balanced settings.
